output.note: In October, your child learned how the pieces move, check and checkmate, and opening principles, demonstrating that they know the opening rules well. They had a great effort solving 20 out of 31 puzzles and reached a best score of 6 in Puzzle Storm. However, your child attended 4 of 8 classes, completed 1 of 6 homework assignments, and lost both of the 2 games they played. The coach noted that your child is quiet in class and needs encouragement, especially as their puzzle rating went from 950 to 930 and they tend to move the queen out too early. For next month, we suggest encouraging your child to complete their homework to help reinforce what they learn in class.

what went well, what to work on, and one concrete suggestion for next month. Call the student 'your child'.
Use only the facts given; never invent a number, a game or an event. No chess notation.
Return only JSON: {"note": "...", "focusNextMonth": ["1 to 3 short items"]}
